sentences.en: With the influence of neo-Eurasianism, Russia's diplomacy is characterized by non-opposability, balance, pragmaticism, independence and initiative.

sentences.en: What we are committed to is a new lifestyle in which man and vehicles coexist harmoniously and happily as well as a life attitude which highlights quality and pragmaticism.
